uncovered_features.feature_name: Multiple condition types per security action
uncovered_features.feature_summary: A single security action can now include multiple condition types, such as IP addresses and ASN numbers, when configured through the API.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Terraform management of Abuse Detection exclusion lists
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Terraform support was added to create and manage Abuse Detection exclusion lists for excluding safe CIDR ranges or IP addresses from incident reporting.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment V2 custom security profile type field
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The API for creating and updating Risk Assessment v2 custom security profiles now accepts an optional risk_assessment_type field to indicate Apigee/Hybrid or API Hub multi-gateway scope.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 VerifyIAM policy support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 now supports the VerifyIAM policy in assessments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection exclusion lists
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection now supports creating and managing multiple exclusion lists to exclude safe traffic from future incident reports.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action status indicators in UI
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The security actions UI now shows status icons and an expired marker for enabled, disabled, paused, and expired security actions.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection incident model quality improvements
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Abuse Detection incident model was improved for lower noise and higher accuracy in incident detection.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection anomaly incident detail view
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection incidents now provide richer anomaly details, including why traffic was flagged, time context, charts, and links to Google Cloud Logging.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Improved abuse incident IP detail performance
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection now loads IP address-specific incident detail information faster for high-traffic IPs.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Shadow API Discovery for any Google Cloud project
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Shadow API Discovery can now be configured and run in any Google Cloud project, with centralized viewing and comparison of discovered APIs against API Hub catalogs.
keywords: Shadow API Discovery any Google Cloud project
compare discovered APIs with API Hub
run Shadow API Discovery in project

uncovered_features.feature_name: Advanced API Security Terraform configuration
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Terraform support has been expanded to configure Advanced API Security settings such as add-on enablement, risk assessment profiles, IP address resolution, and security actions in a declarative workflow.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Advanced API Security security actions edit/delete
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Existing security actions can now be edited and deleted through either the Apigee Console UI or the Apigee Management APIs.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection AppGroups visibility
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection now surfaces AppGroups and AppGroup app context in incidents and detected traffic when that grouping information is present in request traffic.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection API address drill-down
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The detected traffic view in Abuse Detection now includes preview support for drilling down into API address details for investigated abuse events.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection advanced anomaly detection model
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection now uses a new customer-specific Vertex AI anomaly detection model with traffic-data training, replacing the previous model without API or UI changes.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Advanced API Security runtime region expansion
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Advanced API Security runtime availability has been expanded to include the africa-south1 (Johannesburg) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection incident raw data view
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection incident reports now provide raw underlying data, including fields such as client IP, API proxy, and developer app, for deeper investigation.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 monitoring alerts
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 preview adds alerting on security monitoring conditions so changes in security scores can trigger Cloud Monitoring alerts.
keywords: Cloud Monitoring alert on risk score

uncovered_features.feature_name: Shadow API Discovery latency optimization
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Shadow API Discovery has been improved to remove its prior latency impact on load balancers during enablement.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection API key drill-down
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse Detection preview now supports API key drill-down details so detected abuse can be analyzed by the API key involved.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Client IP address resolution UI in environments
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Apigee Console now displays environment-level client IP address resolution settings for easier configuration visibility.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse Detection incident IP address drill-down
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Advanced API Security Abuse Detection incidents now include preview functionality to drill down and view incident details by source IP address.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 custom security profiles
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 gains support for creating custom security profiles with unique combinations of checks and weights.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 multi-profile proxy assessment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 enables proxy risk scoring across multiple security profiles.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 new assessment checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 adds additional assessment checks that can be used in proxy risk scoring.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 profile switching
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Users can switch between security profiles in Risk Assessment v2 to compare scoring differences.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Proxy-specific security actions
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security actions can now be scoped to one or more specific proxies in Advanced API Security.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 percentage score display
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 displays risk score as a percentage, where 100% represents full alignment with the selected security profile.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 public preview
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 is introduced in public preview for Apigee Advanced API Security.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk Assessment v2 score calculation performance improvements
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk Assessment v2 improves score reliability with faster score calculations using recent proxy data.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Shadow API Discovery tagging
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Shadow API Discovery in preview now supports tags to label and organize API observation results.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Advanced API Security data residency
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Advanced API Security now supports configuring regional data residency for stored security data to meet compliance requirements.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Generative AI abuse incident summaries
uncovered_features.feature_summary: A preview feature adds generative AI-powered summaries and recommendations for Abuse Detection incidents.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Shadow API Discovery no-P4SA setup requirement
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Shadow API Discovery preview can be enabled without creating separate Private Google Access (P4SA) permissions.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action rule support for ASN conditions
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security action rules now support Autonomous System Number (ASN) as a condition type.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action rule support for HTTP method conditions
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security action rules now support HTTP methods as a condition type.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action rule support for region code conditions
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security action rules now support region codes as a condition type.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action rule CIDR support for IPv4
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security action rules now support CIDR range specification when matching IPv4 addresses.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action condition types
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security actions can now be triggered by additional condition types, including API keys, API products, access tokens, developers, developer apps, and user agents for finer-grained traffic handling.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse detection model training on customer data
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Apigee now supports optional training of abuse-detection machine learning models on a customer’s own data to improve incident-detection accuracy.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Risk assessment security score performance
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Risk assessment security score loading has been optimized through server-side score caching for faster UI rendering.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security incident archiving
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Users can archive security incidents to remove them from the main incident list while retaining them for later review via unarchive.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Security action quick-create access in security views
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Security action creation links were added directly in Abuse detection and Risk assessment views to create actions in the currently viewed context.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Custom security profiles in Apigee UI
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Customers can create and edit custom security profiles in the Apigee UI to define which security categories contribute to risk scoring.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Advanced API Security alerting
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Advanced API Security alerting enables incident and score-related notifications through Google Cloud Monitoring channels such as email.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Detected Traffic view
uncovered_features.feature_summary: A dedicated Detected Traffic view was added to show API traffic from detected bots and related abuse signals.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Abuse detection
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Abuse detection entered public preview to surface security incidents using machine learning, including Advanced Anomaly Detection and Advanced API Scraper detection rules.
